api: run(AppConfig $actualAppConfig, PDO $sourcePDO, string $privatePlan, string $verifiedProductionArtifactRoot, array $configValues, string $expectedCommit, string $expectedPin): array

requiredPlanFields.expectedCommit: full lowercase Git SHA-1 of clean approved checkout
requiredPlanFields.treeDigest: sha256 of JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES sorted filename map of {sha256,bytes}; includes release-manifest.json; identical to CpanelGitDeploy::digest(CpanelGitDeploy::inventory(root))
requiredPlanFields.pendingMigrations: ordered list of all eight actual candidate pending migration version strings

planPolicy: owner 0600 single-link regular canonical file; parent private root; exclusive consumed-plan digest marker; never retry the same plan
artifactPolicy: flat ReleaseBuilder production artifact, real ReleaseVerifier valid, release.json and public/build-info.json exact clean sourceCommit; no runtime.php until copied and verified
failurePolicy: after conservative source DDL intent always recovery_required and retain maintenance, old trees, encrypted archive/password, journals and token; caller must not clean them; original Throwable available through lastFailure()
receipt: return array; status, lastCompletedStage, sourceDatabaseDdlTouched, maintenanceRetained; after staging also deploymentId, recoveryDirectory, commit, planSha256; later archiveSha256, backupId, rowCount, fileCount and targetDatabase
token: fixed /home/archite4/.a777-deploy/cpanel-token owner 0600; actual verified HTTPS cPanel origin only; runner owns retention/removal
proofBoundary: local token/protocol tests are not native production evidence; run Linux native file fixtures before activation
